description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'ExternalOAuthProviderConnector' implementing OAuth provider handling logic, including obtaining provider instances, authorization URLs, access tokens, refresh tokens, and configuration handling. It is part of a module related to external OAuth connections within SuiteCRM.

classes.name: ExternalOAuthProviderConnector
classes.description: An abstract class providing OAuth2 provider utility methods for SuiteCRM integration, handling provider configuration, authorization flow, token management, and session handling.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Constructs and returns an OAuth2 provider object configured with client credentials and redirect URI, or null if configuration is missing.

methods.name: getAuthorizeURL
methods.description: Generates an authorization URL for OAuth2 authorization flow and stores state in session.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves an access token from the OAuth provider using an authorization code.

methods.name: refreshAccessToken
methods.description: Refreshes an OAuth2 access token using a refresh token.

methods.name: getProviderConfig
methods.description: Fetches the external OAuth provider configuration array from the database.

methods.name: getClientID
methods.description: Determines the applicable client ID based on session, request parameters, or configuration.

methods.name: getClientSecret
methods.description: Determines the applicable client secret based on session, request parameters, or configuration.

methods.name: getRedirectUri
methods.description: Retrieves redirect URI from provider configuration.

methods.name: getExtraProviderParams
methods.description: Retrieves additional provider parameters from configuration.

methods.name: getAuthorizeURLOptions
methods.description: Gets options for building the authorization URL.

methods.name: getAccessTokenRequestOptions
methods.description: Gets options for the access token request.

methods.name: getAccessTokenRequestGrant
methods.description: Determines the grant type for access token requests.

methods.name: getRefreshTokenRequestOptions
methods.description: Gets options for the token refresh request.

methods.name: getRefreshTokenRequestGrant
methods.description: Determines the grant type for refresh token requests.

methods.name: getTokenMapping
methods.description: Retrieves token mapping configuration for token data transformation.

methods.name: getArrayValue
methods.description: Extracts nested array values based on dot notation path.

methods.name: mapTokenDynamically
methods.description: Maps token data to custom format based on token mapping configuration.
